Looking for a staff member?
If you are looking for a staff member, you can use the search page for staff. If you are not sure how their name is spelled, you may want to contact the switchboard, 050 - 363 9111.
You can also search for names by department if you know where the staff member you are looking for works.

If you have reached this page via another website, please let us know where you found this incorrect address so that we can fix the error. Our e-mail address is web@rug.nl. Thank you for your cooperation.
